events.quote: initially the 1st respondent issued show cause notice dated 01.01.2024 to the petitioner.
Thereafter, the petitioner appeared before the 1st respondent and sought time to file reply.

Subsequently, the respondent passed the impugned assessment order dated 20.06.2024 along with summary order dated 21.06.2024 demanding tax along with interest and penalty for the assessment year 2017-2018.
Thereafter, the 2nd respondent passed the attachment order dated 11.12.2024.

defects_argued.quote: In the case on hand, the 1st respondent have issued show cause notice to the petitioner, for which the petitioner sought time to file reply.
Further, it appears that no opportunity of personal hearing was provided to the petitioner prior to the passing of impugned order.

outcome.quote: With the above directions, this writ petition is disposed of.
